Idyllic Hua Hin Haven near Khao Takiab Beach with Daily Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner & Cocktails

Hua Hin, Thailand

Let the gentle waves of Khao Takiab’s powder-white shoreline set the pace at this laid-back seaside resort. Just three hours from Bangkok but a world away from the everyday, this family-friendly oasis offers two sparkling pools, a dedicated children’s pool and an enviable location overlooking the glittering Gulf of Thailand - all within easy reach of Hua Hin’s city centre. Start each sun-drenched day with breakfast at Mosaic, where international favourites meet standout Thai cuisine. For a more casual bite, swing past Coral Lounge or when the sun begins to dip, a tropical cocktail calls at Aqua Pool Bar. While it’s tempting to stay seaside, nearby highlights include eclectic night markets and day trips to Kaeng Krachan National Park. Between adventures, Breeze Spa is on hand for adults seeking a little downtime, while the Kids’ Club keeps little ones happily entertained.

Award-Winning Five-Star Hua Hin Hideaway with Oceanside Beach Club & Restaurant

Hua Hin, Thailand

Your next idyllic escape awaits at Putahracsa Hua Hin, a sophisticated beachfront sanctuary boasting five-star bliss along the glistening eastern shores of Thailand, only a few hours from the bustle of Bangkok. Cradled by golden sands and calm waters, this heritage residence boasts an ultra-luxe collection of rooms and villas that perfectly blend Hua Hin's old-world charm with modern, state-of-the-art luxury. Dine among endless ocean vistas at Oceanside Beach Club & Restaurant, unwind with a full body scrub at the Putahrasca DaySpa or slide into one of three tranquil swimming pools, beautifully dotted across the complex. This incredible luxury resort is ranked in the top 1% on Tripadvisor and was named among the Top 25 Luxury Hotels - Thailand at the Travellers' Choice Best of the Best 2020 awards. Draw yourself away from the fabulous resort and you'll find yourself perfectly placed to discover the best of Hua Hin. Once a quiet fishing village, this Thailand hot-spot has blossomed into a lively town brimming with markets, restaurants, waterparks and more. Whether you explore the neighbourhood on a leisurely bike ride, enjoy a horseback ride along the beach or make waves on a jet ski - when you're done exploring you can retreat to your glamorous room, where you’ll enjoy a beautifully designed space with bespoke furniture and tranquil views.

Hua Hin, Thailand

Boutique Hua Hin Coastal Retreat with Private Beach

Hua Hin, Thailand

Seaside charm comes in waves at Devasom Hua Hin Resort, a boutique resort located on a peaceful stretch of private beach between the Hua Hin and Chaam districts of central Thailand. Just 23 guest rooms and villas make for an intimate escape, perfect for a romantic holiday. Spend your evenings at Deva Bistro, where you can dine on mouthwatering local Thai and western dishes alongside an extensive wine list in a serene, beachside setting. During the day, a range of fabulous facilities promise unforgettable adventures: choose fun-filled watersports, relax with a traditional Thai massage or learn some new skills at the complimentary Thai cooking class (additional charges may apply; bookings required). The resort's location places you in prime position to explore Hua Hin and its many attractions. Keen golfers will enjoy a swing at the Royal Hua Hin Golf Course, just a 15-minute drive away. For a taste of local culture, visit the Hua Hin Night Market and Cicada Market, both approximately a 20-minute drive from the resort. For a day in the sun, the famous Hua Hin Beach is just 15 minutes away by car.
